phases.name: Foundation
phases.focus: Establish base aerobic capacity and safe entry with controlled progression

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Increase running volume and introduce structured intervals with steady progressions

phases.name: Peak & Taper
phases.focus: Sharpen speed and endurance, reduce load leading into 5K goal

non_negotiables: avoid cold-air high-intensity work without a plan

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary running:
    name "Complete a 5K distance in 12 weeks with controlled progression and proper warm-up"
PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Run training 20m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          jog 5m
          dynamic_mrep 30s
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 1x8 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Strength training 30m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squats 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch_calf 30s
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Run/Walk training 25m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          jog 3m
          leg_m swing 30s
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Strength training 30m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_lunges 3x10 per leg rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_walk_clip 2x20m rpe 3
        cooldown:
          stretch_hamstring 30s
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Run/Walk 28m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          jog 4m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Strength training 30m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 per leg rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x20s rpe 3
        cooldown:
          stretch_quads 30s
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Run/Walk 30m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x8 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Strength training 30m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          single_leg_deadlift_trainer 3x10 per leg rop  rpe 4
        cooldown:
          stretch_hamstring 30s
  PHASE "Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Run/Walk 32m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          light_jog 3m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x8 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          incline_walk 2x60s rpe 3
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Run 20m continuous (easy) training:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          light_jog 3m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch_walk 5m
      DAY Strength training 30m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10 per arm rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30s
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Run/Walk 34m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          light_jog 4m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x6 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Run 22m continuous (easy) training:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          jog 3m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x16 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch_quads 30s
      DAY Strength training 30m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 4
          step_up 3x12 per leg rpe 4
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 4
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 30s
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Run/Walk 36m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x6 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Run 24m continuous (steady) training:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          jog 3m
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch_calf 30s
      DAY Strength training 30m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 4
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 4
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 3
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30s
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Run/Walk 38m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          light_jog 6m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x6 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Run 26m continuous (steady) training:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          jog 4m
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x8 km?  rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch_hamstring 30s
      DAY Strength training 30m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift_variant 3x8 rpe 4
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 4
          farmer_walk 2x30s
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 60s
  PHASE "Peak & Taper" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Run 28m easy:
        warmup:
          gentle_walk 5m
          60s jog
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x20 rpe 4 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Run/Walk 32m: 
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x6 rpe 4 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Strength training 25m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12
          step_up 3x10 per leg
          push_up 3x8
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30s
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Run 30m steady:
        warmup:
          walk 5m
          jog 4m
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x8 rpe 4 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Run 18m easy continuous:
        warmup:
          walk 5m
          jog 2m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x18 rpe 4 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          stretch_quads 30s
      DAY Strength training 25m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10
          lat_pulldown 3x10
          tricep_pushdown 3x12
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 30s
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Run 34m with accelerated finish:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x6 rpe 4 rest 90s
          final_sprint 4x30s rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Run 20m steady:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          jog 3m
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          stretch_hamstring 30s
      DAY Strength training 25m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift_variant 3x6
          dumbbell_fly 3x12
          face_pull 3x12
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30s
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Run 25m easy to moderate (Race Prep):
        warmup:
          walk 5m
          jog 3m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x18 rpe 4 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Run 5K simulation (cool-down mode):
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x5k rpe 5 rest 0s
        cooldown:
          stretch_all 120s
      DAY Rest or Mobility 20m:
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_flexor_stretch 30s
          quad_stretch 30s
          thoracic_mrotation 60s
        cooldown:
          deep_breathing 2m
NON_NEGOTIABLES
  - Always warm up properly
  - avoid cold-air high-intensity work without a plan
